theme.accent_gold: Copper (#A25737); gold remains in actual product photography

typography.heading_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif text-[#4A150B] tracking-tight leading-tight
typography.heading_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif text-[#3D2B22] tracking-normal

bead_auto_scroller_rail.description: Left-side automatically scrolling rail (1–14 Mukhi + Gauri Shankar + Ganesh) with right-side synchronized content update (Name, Deity, Mantra, 3-4 line explanation).
bead_auto_scroller_rail.layout: Flex/Grid 2-column layout (Left: 40% vertical auto-scroll bead reel, Right: 60% dynamic synchronized details panel).

siddha_mala_interactive_focus_map.description: Circular/Diagram view of 1 to 14 Mukhi + Gauri Shankar + Ganesh with central Siddha Mala PNG. Clicking any bead focuses its physical location on the Mala with an animated halo glow and brings up transparent PNG details.
siddha_mala_interactive_focus_map.layout: Interactive focal map with absolute percentage-based highlight nodes surrounding the mala.

celebrity_alternating_carousel.description: 5-second auto-playing carousel with pause on hover.
alternating_layout: Card 1: Photo Left (Milind Soman), Story Right
Card 2: Story Left, Photo Right (Dimple Kapadia)
Card 3: Photo Left (Sunanda Shetty - Shilpa Shetty's Mom), Story Right

shiva_legend_interlude.description: Mythological origin of Rudraksha & Siddha Mala with Shiva imagery, Mahamrityunjaya Mantra audio-visual feel, warm gold typography, and subtle parallax background.

expert_panel.description: High-definition expert portraits with credentials, certification seal, and direct consultation lead booking form.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, mala beads, carousel dots) MUST include unique data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='bead-focus-1-mukhi').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.file_type_rule: Project uses JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components. Share guidelines tailored for .js / .jsx codebase.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_states: Hover states must explicit set text color and gold/warm-shadow border highlights.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_white_backgrounds: Strictly avoid pure white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds and flat black (#000000) text. Use warm peach-white (#FAF5EE) and rich mahogany (#2C1A11).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.cms_integration: Retain full CMS functionality, admin auth modal, dual enquiry forms, and lead collection intact.
